slug: 2025-12-01 Biometric Digital-ID in Africa - Ten Country Case Studies

systems.system: Biometric national identity card (CNI) digital-ID programme
systems.platform: Idemia biometric technology; Semlex as current project operator
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior and Security, implemented by ONECI with support of the Ministry of Digital Transformation
systems.tiers: national enrolment; about 8 million citizens registered by 2024; registration centres limited in rural areas
national: a single database of natural persons unifying civil status data

note: The Côte d'Ivoire passages describe the biometric identity card and the population register (class identity) only; nothing is stated about how a civil registration office records a birth or death. The other passages concern other countries.
